author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Fixed asset photos being unrecognizable — full-body product shots were squeezed into a short 100px banner with a hard crop (cutting off the head on manikins), and used the server's pre-cropped square 'thumb' size on top of that. Switched to the uncropped 'lores' image fit with objectFit=contain, and moved the photo to the left side of the card (was stacked on top) with the name/details on the right — the whole product is visible now, not just a cropped middle section.
